# T14 visual fixtures

These original fixtures are used only to check badge rendering. They are not
product artwork and are not included in the application bundle.

- `geometric-cross.svg` covers a regular, thin-lined vector mask.
- `t14-asymmetric.png` covers an asymmetric silhouette, an internal hole, and
  transparent padding.
- `code.svg` in `src/assets/` covers a built-in icon.
- `t14-text-f.png` is a transparent system-UI `F` glyph mask rasterized at 390px
  on macOS 26.6.2; storing the mask keeps the output baseline independent of
  later font changes.

The fixtures are original project material under the project MIT license.
